findings.fix: Remove the media query that hides #main-content in portrait, or provide the same content in an alternative accessible layout.
findings.violation: A CSS media query hides the main content in portrait orientation, restricting the page to landscape only.

findings.fix: Remove style="outline:none" and use CSS to style the focus state instead of hiding it.
findings.violation: This link has style="outline:none" which removes the keyboard focus indicator, making it invisible to keyboard users.

findings.evidence: <div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol" style="width:16px;height:16px">
findings.fix: Increase the target size to at least 44×44 CSS pixels, or add padding around the visual element.
findings.violation: This custom button control is 16×16 CSS pixels (width:16px;height:16px), below the 44×44 pixel minimum target size.

findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the input to link the error message.
findings.violation: This input has aria-invalid="true" and an associated error message, but the error span is not programmatically linked via aria-describedby.

findings.fix: Set the field's autocomplete attribute to email, or the matching standard token for this input purpose.
findings.violation: This field's type, name, or id identifies the email input purpose, but it carries no autocomplete token, so the purpose is not programmatically determinable.

findings.fix: Add aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" to announce this status message to screen readers.
findings.location: #s3-statuscard, <div> region, text 'Your changes are saved.', line 41
findings.violation: This status message lacks aria-live attribute, so screen readers will not announce the saved state to users.
